channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Christmas At The Movies
item.description: 🎄 Something special is coming to Rochdale Town Hall this Christmas! 🐑 Shaun the Sheep, festive film favourites and the spectacular sound of a live brass band… all in one magical afternoon! 🎬 Keep your eyes peeled for more details! 👀 Rochdale, Town Hall, The Esplanade, Rochdale OL16 1AZ, UK

item.title: Christmas lights switch-ons 2026: dates, times and road closures in Rochdale, Heywood, Middleton, Littleborough and Norden
item.description: Heywood and Middleton switch on this Saturday 14 November, Rochdale and Norden on Sunday 22 November and Littleborough on Saturday 28 November.

item.title: Prime Minister Andy Burnham supports reinstatement of Heywood express bus service
item.description: Andy Burnham backs calls for the return of the 167 bus service from Heywood to Manchester, which was cut in 2012.

item.title: Rochdale AFC to host York City in League Two clash this Saturday
item.description: Rochdale AFC welcomes York City to the Crown Oil Arena for a Sky Bet League Two match this Saturday, 12 November.

item.title: Rochdale Council launches Christmas Toy Appeal for local children in need
item.description: The Christmas Toy Appeal aims to support local children living in poverty by collecting donations until 11 December.

item.title: Middleton man charged with assaulting emergency worker after Lodge Street stop
item.description: Lee Cartledge, 42, faces four charges following a vehicle stop in Middleton on Wednesday 11 November, Greater Manchester Police said.

item.title: Trafalgar Street, roadworks in Rochdale on 26 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Trafalgar Street in Rochdale; expected timings: 12noon–4pm on Thursday, 26 November 2026.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Thursday 12 November 2026
item.description: 14 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Rochdale’s own Stonehenge? What archaeologists actually know about the moorland stones
item.description: Surveys and excavations show Bronze Age cairns and widespread prehistoric flint scatters on the moors above Rochdale — but the idea of a local ‘Stonehenge’ is disputed and needs more professional study.

item.title: Christmas giving in Rochdale: the toy appeal, the foodbank and the mayor's charities
item.description: New, unwrapped toys for children aged up to 16 are needed by Friday 11 December, while Rochdale Foodbank is short of juice, rice, toothpaste and coffee.

item.title: Police search for man who helped woman after alleged sexual assault in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police are appealing for information regarding a man who assisted a woman following an alleged sexual assault in Rochdale town centre.

item.title: ILEARN International Limited to be wound up following resolutions
item.description: ILEARN International Limited, based in Rochdale, has passed resolutions for voluntary winding-up, appointing a liquidator to oversee the process.

item.title: Sanderson's Floor & Roof Truss Company Limited enters liquidation
item.description: Sanderson's Floor & Roof Truss Company Limited, based at 179 Milnrow Road, Rochdale, has entered liquidation as of 12 November 2026, according to an official notice in The Gazette.

item.title: Rochdale Council reminds parents of primary school application deadline
item.description: Parents must apply for their child's primary school place by 15 January 2027 to secure their preferred choice, warns Rochdale Council.

item.title: Ramsden Road in Wardle to close for Christmas Eve carol concert
item.description: Part of Ramsden Road in Wardle will close from 5.30pm to 7.30pm on Thursday 24 December 2026 for the Wardle Village Christmas Eve Carol Concert. There will be no alternative route for vehicles.

item.title: Cartridge Street, roadworks in Heywood from 11 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Cartridge Street in Heywood; expected timings: The closure began at 10.29am on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. Work will continue for a maximum of 21 days (2 December 2026), or when repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Springhill Hospice appeals for volunteers to collect Christmas trees in January
item.description: Springhill Hospice needs volunteers and drivers with vans or trucks for its Christmas tree recycling collections from Friday 15 to Monday 18 January 2027.

item.title: Super Stories with Eliza Says launches at Alkrington Library
item.description: Alkrington Library will host 'Super Stories with Eliza Says', a new children's event featuring songs and British Sign Language, starting this month.

item.title: Man arrested after suspected air pistol found near Rochdale Armistice Day ceremony
item.description: A 39-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of possessing an imitation firearm after police found what they believe is an air pistol near the Armistice Day ceremony in Rochdale town centre.

item.title: Rochdale arts leader Parvez Qadir wins This Is Manchester award
item.description: The founder of Rochdale-based Breaking Barriers has been recognised for making a difference through arts and community work.

item.title: Rochdale shop iREEF named Marine Fish Retailer of the Year 2026
item.description: iREEF, a Rochdale-based aquatic retailer, has been awarded Marine Fish Retailer of the Year in Practical Fishkeeping's annual Readers' Poll.

item.title: Six-week electrical training course opens to unemployed adults in Rochdale
item.description: Rochdale Training has places on two six-week programmes starting in December and January, with compulsory information sessions before enrolment.

item.title: Middleton man charged with attempted murder and three aggravated burglaries
item.description: A 33-year-old man from the Middleton area is due before Manchester Magistrates' Court following charges relating to alleged incidents in Oldham.

item.title: Man who died in Baguley Crescent flat fire in Middleton named as David Mills, 67
item.description: David Steven Mills died at the scene of a fire in his first-floor flat on Saturday 7 November. Police say there are no suspicious circumstances.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 11 November 2026
item.description: 13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Six dental practices in Rochdale borough listed as taking new NHS adult patients
item.description: NHS listings show six practices accepting new adult patients and eight accepting children. None in Heywood or Littleborough is taking adults.

item.title: Tributes paid to former Rochdale councillor Shaun O’Neill following his death
item.description: Shaun O’Neill, a former Labour councillor for Healey, has passed away, prompting heartfelt tributes from the community and local leaders.

item.title: Inquest reveals details surrounding death of former rugby player Michael Martindale
item.description: An inquest has revealed significant details surrounding the death of Michael Martindale, a former rugby league player, who was found dead in Oldham with multiple injuries.

item.title: River Beal Takeaway in Milnrow crowned best in North West at Euro Asia Curry Awards
item.description: River Beal Takeaway has been awarded the title of best takeaway in the North West at the Euro Asia Curry Awards 2026, reflecting its quality and regional reputation.

item.title: ACS Detailing Ltd enters liquidation in Newhey
item.description: ACS Detailing Ltd, located at 20 Shaw Road, Newhey, Rochdale, has been placed into liquidation, according to an official notice published in The Gazette on 11 November 2026. The company, which specialised in engineering design activities for industrial processes and production, has appointed Ian James Royle and David Adam Broadbent of BTG Begbies Traynor as

item.title: North West Removals and Storage Limited to be wound up voluntarily
item.description: North West Removals and Storage Limited, based at Unit 5c, Gorrels Way, Rochdale, has passed resolutions to wind up the company voluntarily as of 6 November 2026. The resolutions were made during a meeting where Daniel Ormerod and Lauren Fitton of Leonard Curtis were appointed as joint liquidators to manage the winding-up process.

item.title: Shawclough Road, roadworks in Rochdale from 10 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Shawclough Road in Rochdale; expected timings: Work started at 3.07am on Tuesday, 10 November 2026. Work will continue for a maximum of 21 days (1 December 2026), or until work is complete if sooner..

item.title: Rochdale weather forecast: Rain and mild temperatures expected this week
item.description: Rochdale residents can expect a mix of rain and mild temperatures over the next ten days, according to the latest forecast from Netweather.

item.title: Rochdale AFC launches new weekly show 'Behind The Sign'
item.description: Rochdale AFC has launched a new weekly show called 'Behind The Sign', aimed at sharing stories from all corners of the club. The pilot episode was released on 10 November 2026, providing fans with an inside look at the team's activities and community involvement.

item.title: Heywood Christmas Toy Appeal seeks donations to support families in need
item.description: The Christmas Toy Appeal, organised by local council staff, aims to provide gifts for children living in poverty in Heywood and surrounding areas.

item.title: Milnrow and Middleton men among 16 charged with violent disorder before Manchester football match
item.description: Sixteen men, including defendants from Milnrow and Middleton, have been charged with violent disorder over an incident before a football match in Manchester in September 2024.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Tuesday 10 November 2026
item.description: 15 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Littleborough pub launches new pool league to strengthen community ties
item.description: Admiral Taverns pub in Littleborough invites local venues to join a new pool league, fostering community spirit and competition among players.

item.title: Rochdale house prices average £211,000, below UK average of £273,100
item.description: Rochdale is among eight Greater Manchester areas where house prices are below the UK average of £273,100, with a 3.3% rise over the past year.

item.title: CEAMS wins national award for sustainable manufacturing innovation
item.description: The Centre of Expertise in Advanced Materials and Sustainability (CEAMS) has received national recognition for its innovative work in recycling carbon fibre.

item.title: Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal seeks donations to support local children
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council is calling for donations for its Christmas Toy Appeal, which helps local children in need. Donations are accepted until 11 December 2026.

item.title: Rochdale fighter Owen Webster loses BKFC bout in Glasgow but keeps the town behind him
item.description: Webster was stopped by Dan Morel in the fourth round at the OVO Hydro on Saturday and has thanked the fans who travelled, saying he will be back better than ever.

item.title: Dunelm Rochdale shoppers fill store with Christmas gifts for Delivering Joy appeal
item.description: The Rochdale store says customers have dropped off so many presents in the past week that staff are preparing a count. Gifts go to local causes for people who might otherwise go without.

item.title: School-run parking in Rochdale: what can the council do?
item.description: The council has stepped up patrols outside schools and is consulting on School Streets. New pavement parking powers are on the way from the government.

item.title: Cranmer Education Trust staff gather for professional development event
item.description: Staff from Cranmer Education Trust, which operates schools in Middleton and Oldham, convened for a professional development event aimed at improving children's lives through inclusive education.

item.title: Rochdale man who managed 'Adam' drug line dealers jailed for 10 and a half years
item.description: Haider Ali, 34, of Pike Street, was sentenced at Minshull Street Crown Court on Monday 9 November after an investigation that began with a drug deal on Baron Street.

item.title: Comment: Should fireworks be allowed on any night but bonfire night?
item.description: Rochdale's council displays went quiet this year, but residents say fireworks carried on into this week. We look at the law, the harm to people and animals, and what could change.

item.title: Police warn Rochdale homes to lock away family gold after rise in burglaries
item.description: Burglaries targeting family gold have risen in Rochdale, Oldham and Bury in recent weeks, mostly at weekends, with entry usually gained at the rear of homes.

item.title: Wirral thrash Rochdale 46-0 in rugby match
item.description: Wirral secured a dominant 46-0 victory over Rochdale, moving up to third in the league table ahead of their next match against Leek.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Monday 9 November 2026
item.description: 17 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.
